session_protocol_violations.message: Protocol 'PaymentChannel' never terminates: the reachable states Idle -> ServerWait -> ClientWait all hand control to another role (payment_client_request (tests/fixtures/session_types/payment_client.mm), payment_server_respond (tests/fixtures/session_types/payment_server.mm), payment_client_retry (tests/fixtures/session_types/payment_client.mm)), so the participants wait on each other in a cycle.
session_protocol_violations.suggested_fix: Give one role an 'effect_post' that reaches a state without outgoing transitions (for effect 'PaymentChannel': Settled), so the protocol can complete.

agent_artifact_mapping.description: Caller/callee contract violations correspond to agent-reported constraints that the implementation path does not enforce.
Conflicting global invariants correspond to spec-level divergences before migration or repair.
Session protocol violations correspond to communication ordering constraints that the participating specifications do not enforce.
Cycles that change dependency meaning are surfaced as drift issues for human and MCP review.
